## Common WHERE Filters

### 分区过滤

```sql
-- 单日
WHERE grass_region = upper('${region}')
  AND grass_date = date('${grass_date}')

-- 日期范围
WHERE grass_date >= date('${date1}')
  AND grass_date <= date('${date2}')
```

### 业务过滤

```sql
-- CPC 扣费失败 (常用)
WHERE deduct_type = 1

-- CPC + CPM 扣费失败
WHERE deduct_type in (1, 2)

-- Search Ads pricing types
WHERE pricing_type in (11, 15, 24, 25, 27)

-- 排除 Manual/Live Ads (Product Ads 归因场景)
WHERE cast(pricing_type as int) not in (5, 6, 9, 10, 14)

-- 非成功扣费（含余额不足导致的失败）
WHERE status <> 1
   OR (status = 1 AND campaign_balance_by_date.daily_balance = daily_quota)
```

FROM mp_paidads.dwd_log_translog_unsuccessful_event_deduction_di__reg_s0_live d

  AND d.grass_region = a.grass_region

```

```

## Common Aggregations

### 按 deduct_type 分别聚合

```sql
SELECT
    grass_region,
    grass_date,
    count(distinct user_id) as deduct_user_cnt,
    sum(if(deduct_type = 1, 1, 0)) as deduct_fail_cpc_cnt,
    sum(if(deduct_type = 2, 1, 0)) as deduct_fail_cpm_cnt,
    sum(if(deduct_type = 1,
        (coalesce(price, 0) - coalesce(adjusted_cost, 0))
        / 100000.0 / nullif(x.exchange_rate, 0), 0)) as deduct_fail_cpc_amt_usd,
    sum(if(deduct_type = 2,
        (coalesce(price, 0) - coalesce(adjusted_cost, 0))
        / 100000.0 / nullif(x.exchange_rate, 0), 0)) as deduct_fail_cpm_amt_usd
FROM mp_paidads.dwd_log_translog_unsuccessful_event_deduction_di__reg_s0_live d
JOIN exchange_rate x ON d.grass_region = x.grass_region AND d.grass_date = x.grass_date
WHERE d.grass_date >= date('${date1}')
  AND d.grass_date <= date('${date2}')
  AND d.pricing_type in (11, 15, 24, 25, 27)
  AND d.deduct_type in (1, 2)
GROUP BY 1, 2
```

### Snippet 1: AB 实验扣费失败率分析 (debug7)

```sql
deduct_agg as (
    select
        a.bucket,
        d.grass_region,
        d.grass_date,
        count(distinct a.user_id) as deduct_user_cnt,
        sum(if(d.deduct_type = 1, 1, 0)) as deduct_fail_cpc_cnt,
        sum(if(d.deduct_type = 2, 1, 0)) as deduct_fail_cpm_cnt,
        sum(if(d.deduct_type = 1,
            (coalesce(d.price, 0) - coalesce(d.adjusted_cost, 0))
            / 100000.0 / nullif(x.exchange_rate, 0), 0)) as deduct_fail_cpc_amt_usd,
        sum(if(d.deduct_type = 2,
            (coalesce(d.price, 0) - coalesce(d.adjusted_cost, 0))
            / 100000.0 / nullif(x.exchange_rate, 0), 0)) as deduct_fail_cpm_amt_usd
    from mp_paidads.dwd_log_translog_unsuccessful_event_deduction_di__reg_s0_live d
    join assignment_t a
        on d.user_id = a.user_id
        and d.grass_region = a.grass_region
        and d.grass_date = a.grass_date
    join xr x
        on d.grass_region = x.grass_region
        and d.grass_date = x.grass_date
    where d.grass_date >= date('${date1}')
        and d.grass_date <= date('${date2}')
        and d.pricing_type in (11, 15, 24, 25, 27)
        and d.deduct_type in (1, 2)
    group by 1, 2, 3
)
```

### Snippet 2: CPC 扣费失败收入归因 (debug1)

```sql
-- CPC unsuccessful deduction.
select
    'cpc' as billing_type
    ,a.campaign_id
    ,a.shop_id
    ,a.user_id
    ,a.entrance
    ,a.placement
    ,cast(a.pricing_type as int) as pricing_type
    ,0 as fraud_event
    ,0 as duplicated_event
    ,a.price as expect_rev_local
    ,a.adjusted_cost as real_rev_local
    ,0.0 as tracking_expect_rev_local
    ,a.grass_region
    ,a.grass_date
from mp_paidads.dwd_log_translog_unsuccessful_event_deduction_di__reg_s0_live a
where a.grass_region = upper('${region}')
    and a.grass_date = date('${grass_date}')
    and cast(a.pricing_type as int) not in (5, 6, 9, 10, 14)
    and a.deduct_type = 1
    and (
        a.status <> 1
        or (
            a.status = 1
            and a.campaign_balance_by_date.daily_balance = a.daily_quota
        )
    )
```
